title: Three Terms and One Short Ruler
subtitle: 数学逻辑 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数学逻辑（人与社会·科学与技术·数学与逻辑）
meta: 主题语境：数学逻辑（人与社会·科学与技术·数学与逻辑）　|　核心词汇：geometry　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 geometry 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the surveyor ① studied the geometry that no apprentice in the office would have described, and he said the studying was the whole of the term. The ② geometry, meaning the figures themselves and not the sums, ran three terms and stayed undescribed in the book; geometry, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of geometry in that office had the same short ruler beside it, and the ④ geometry at the far board, meaning the figure they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Geometry, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the surveyor said the describing is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the geometry was the whole of the matter, meaning the shape and not the figures. The ⑥ geometry, meaning the shape and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; geometry, he said, is either something you study or the only word that means both a figure and a shape. He said the shape is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ geometry had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short ruler. The ⑧ geometry of the whole thing, the surveyor wrote in November, was one office and three terms of describing; geometry, he said, is either the figure at the far board or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ geometry I remember is the figure described in the plan, which closed in 1971 and is still described as the quietest in the office. ⑩ Geometry, my mother said in 1973, is the only subject that improves by being described; all geometry, she said, is a shape that has agreed to look like a figure. She said the shape was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 几何（指办公室里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 几何（指那些图形本身，与算术相对）
C. 固定搭配：study the geometry 研究几何
D. n. 几何（指留给孩子们临摹的那张图）
E. n. 几何（抽象总称，指一间办公室的几何教学之事）
F. n. 几何（指讲义里写到、被记录过的那张图）
G. n. 几何形状；几何结构（指一件事里人人都画却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: study the geometry 意为“研究几何”，1964 年那位测量员研究了办公室里没有一位学徒肯描述的几何。
geometry 意为“几何”，指那些图形本身而不是算术，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。
geometry 意为“几何”，指办公室里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一把矮矮的尺子。
geometry 意为“几何”，指最远那块板上留给孩子们临摹的那张图，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
geometry 意为“几何形状、几何结构”，指一件事里人人都画却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个结构就是那件事的全部。
geometry 意为“几何结构”，指人人都画却无人提起的那样东西而不是那些图形，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
geometry 意为“几何”，指讲义里写到、被记录过的那张图，到 1969 年这张图成了方案里的一行。
geometry 意为“几何”，测量员十一月写道，整件事的几何教学之事是一间办公室和三个学期的描述。
geometry 意为“几何”，我记得的是方案里描述过的那张图，1971 年擦掉了，至今仍被说成办公室里最安静的一张。
geometry 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，几何是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的学科。
